It adds a 4-working-hour review deadline after which any of the three can pick up the PR, and it tracks ready-to-approved wait time in the existing tracker. It skips squads, chapters, Jira Align and workshops for now and would revisit tooling only if wait time stays high after a couple of weeks. It ends by asking the user to confirm the lead will no longer be the default sole approver. Unmet need: it has no labeled decision record.
